Title: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) now supports confidential workloads through DCSv2 SKUs (private preview)

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) now supports confidential workloads through integration with DCsv2-series SKU node pools (in preview).  

This service allows you to add DC series node pools powered by Intel SGX to your existing AKS cluster or provision a new AKS cluster with DC series node pools to orchestrate the enclave applications—developed with the Open Enclave SDK, the Intel SGX SDK, or ISV confidential apps—alongside regular container applications in the same cluster.

To sign up for the private preview, submit this form. 

Please note that regular Azure pricing for DCsv2 and AKS applies to the preview period.
